EmailTemplate.description: Sent to a channel partner when its site visit request is approved (Partner Portal Setting: Visit Confirmed Email Template). [[Customer]], [[Visit Date]] and [[Visit Time]] are filled in by PartnerSiteVisitService.
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Site Visit Confirmed
EmailTemplate.subject: Your site visit with [[Customer]] is confirmed
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Visit__c.OwnerFullName},
John Keells Properties has approved your site visit request for [[Customer]]. The site visit is scheduled as shown below.
Customer: [[Customer]] Project: {!Visit__c.Project__c} Date: [[Visit Date]] Time: [[Visit Time]]
AFTER THE VISIT Once the date and time of the visit have passed, record the outcome on the Partner Portal: Leads → Edit → Visited, then choose this visit. If the customer visited, click Update stage. The JKP CP team then takes the lead over. If the customer did not come, click Customer did not visit. You can then request a new site visit. To change the date or time, please contact the JKP CP team.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
